title: Asscher diamond pendant, 18K gold
subtitle: The Asscher cut is not about fire — it is about depth. Step facets draw the eye downward through concentric squares, creating a hall-of-mirrors effect that no brilliant cut can produce. Six of them set together in sequence compound that effect: each stone's depth connects to the next, and the visual field runs through all six simultaneously. The pendant was built to hold six Asschers in a line without interruption.
